drums.description: Modern rock instrumental with a focus on rhythmic precision and dynamic layering, The track features a prominent, dry acoustic drum kit with a crisp snare and tight hi-hats, A distorted electric guitar plays syncopated, palm-muted riffs and power chord stabs, A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with bright, arpeggiated figures, The electric bass is overdriven, locking tightly with the kick drum in a driving eighth-note pattern, The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time, The arrangement builds through the addition of layered guitar tracks and increased cymbal activity, utilizing a stop-start dynamic where the instruments drop out for brief rhythmic pauses, The production is clean and punchy, with minimal reverb on the rhythm section to maintain a tight, aggressive feel Publish

vocals.description: Industrial techno with dark ambient and EBM influences, The track features a distorted, resonant kick drum with a long decay, layered with a metallic, high-frequency percussion loop, A gritty, overdriven monophonic synth bass plays a syncopated 16th-note pattern, Atmospheric elements include a low-pass filtered sawtooth pad that swells periodically and a high-pitched, dissonant digital lead with heavy delay and reverb, A rhythmic, mechanical noise loop provides a constant textural layer, The tempo is 135 BPM in the key of C minor, The arrangement focuses on incremental filter modulation and the introduction of percussive layers rather than melodic progression Publish
